effect.name: GM Color Link
effect.desc: Samples the composition below and links its live palette, luminance and saturation to the current layer.
effect.shader: vec3 gmAvg(sampler2D t){vec3 s=vec3(0.0);s+=texture2DCv(t,vec2(.18,.18)).rgb;s+=texture2DCv(t,vec2(.5,.18)).rgb;s+=texture2DCv(t,vec2(.82,.18)).rgb;s+=texture2DCv(t,vec2(.18,.5)).rgb;s+=texture2DCv(t,vec2(.5,.5)).rgb;s+=texture2DCv(t,vec2(.82,.5)).rgb;s+=texture2DCv(t,vec2(.18,.82)).rgb;s+=texture2DCv(t,vec2(.5,.82)).rgb;s+=texture2DCv(t,vec2(.82,.82)).rgb;return s/9.0;} void main(){vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm);vec3 ref=gmAvg(comp.texture),own=gmAvg(inputImg.texture);float rl=dot(ref,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722)),ol=dot(own,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));vec3 refChr=ref/max(rl,.001),ownChr=own/max(ol,.001);vec3 c=src.rgb*mix(vec3(1.0),refChr/max(ownChr,vec3(.05)),paletteStrength);float l=dot(c,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));c*=mix(1.0,rl/max(l,.001),lumaStrength);float sat=max(max(ref.r,ref.g),ref.b)-min(min(ref.r,ref.g),ref.b);c=mix(vec3(dot(c,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722))),c,mix(1.0,0.5+sat*2.0,saturationStrength));c=(c-0.5)*contrast+0.5;float warm=smoothstep(0.02,0.35,src.r-src.b)*smoothstep(0.05,0.5,src.g);c=mix(c,src.rgb,warm*preserveSkin);gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(src.rgb,c,mixAmount),src.a);}
